PLAN "General Strength - L4-L5 Recovery"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build functional strength with spine-safe loading patterns"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Movement Quality & Stability" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Push & Core Stability":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          arm_circles 2x10
          scapular_retraction 2x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 90 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 90 seconds
          child_pose 90 seconds

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Body & Anti-Rotation":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_swings 2x10
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 90 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 90 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 90 seconds

      DAY Friday training 50m "Upper Pull & Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          arm_circles 2x10
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
